text:
Noah Rivera: Quick flag 00hrs PT  PR #1312 preview failed on linkcheck + markdown-lint. Small set of issues but want to coordinate reviewers before I push fixes. Preview: https://redwood-docs-preview/pr-1312

docs-ci-bot: [docs-preview] Build failed  linkcheck: 2 broken links; markdownlint: 1 rule violation (MD033); spellcheck: 0. Full log: https://ci.redwood/1256/log

Priya Kapoor: can you paste the linkcheck output?

Noah Rivera: yep, output snippet below:

```
LinkCheck: ERROR Broken link: docs/reference/sdk-python.md -> https://pypi.example.com/project/redwoodsdk (404)
LinkCheck: WARNING Relative link points to heading not found: docs/examples/chat-streaming.md#streaming-configuration
```

Julian Park: the PyPI link is probably an old placeholder. We should point to our packages.redwood.ai entry or internal artifact page. For the anchor, maybe the header changed in a docs refactor. Noah, can you check the latest headings in chat-streaming.md?

Noah Rivera: browsing file now. The section is called "Configuring streaming" not "Streaming configuration"  I'll update the anchor.

Priya Kapoor: markdownlint flagged MD033 (inline HTML). Any inline HTML in the PR?

Noah Rivera: doh, I copied a small <kbd>Enter</kbd> example from a forum thread. I can replace with backticks and a short note.

Julian Park: prefer not to allow inline HTML unless it's necessary for a complex table. Replace with code formatting. Also remove the trailing space at line 88 (noticed by linter).

Noah Rivera: plan: (1) swap PyPI link to https://packages.redwood.ai/redwood-sdk-python; (2) change anchor to #configuring-streaming; (3) replace <kbd>Enter</kbd> with `Enter` and strip trailing whitespace. Any objections?

Priya Kapoor: sounds good. Quick reminder: if the external link is replaced, add a short parenthetical "(archived: previously linked to pypi.example.com)" and include a Wayback URL if we have an archived copy. Keeps traceability.

Noah Rivera: will do. Also adding a one-line changelog entry in the PR description about link and lint fix to speed up reviewers.

docs-ci-bot: Tip: you can re-run preview with `git commit --allow-empty -m "docs: retrigger preview"` or push the fixes.

Noah Rivera: pushing fixes now. Commit: `docs: fix links + md-lint (sdk link, anchor, inline html) (#1312)` pushed at 1965443238

docs-ci-bot: [docs-preview] Rebuild queued by noah.r. Rebuilding...

docs-ci-bot: [docs-preview] Build succeeded  linkcheck: 0 errors, markdownlint: 0 violations, spellcheck: 0. Preview: https://redwood-docs-preview/pr-1312/preview

Priya Kapoor: reviewing the tiny change now. LGTM for the anchor and code formatting. The packages.redwood.ai link resolves fine.

Julian Park: LGTM as well. Small nit: tighten the example wording from "press Enter key" to "press Enter". Not blocking.

Noah Rivera: thanks both. I'll merge once CI green and after waiting 10 minutes for any late comments. Appreciate the quick help. :party_panda:
